SetSubframe

The SetSubframe method specifies whether this frame is currently a subframe of its containing frame. 
void SetSubframe (in ODBoolean isSubframe);
isSubframe
kODTrue if this frame is currently a subframe of its containing frame, otherwise kODFalse.
SEE ALSO
The ODFrame::IsSubframe method (page 330).
"Using Subframes to Suppress the Active Frame Border" on page 153 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
